brief.summary: Equities are modestly higher, with S&P futures up 0.1% and Nasdaq up 0.4%, while front-end Treasury yields rose about 5 bp and the 10-year added 3 bp, flattening the curve. The dollar is firm on reduced fiscal-risk premium and expectations of Fed hawkishness. Brent fell more than 2% on pipeline-restart hopes, credit spreads remain tight, and gold was cited only as a hedge. The Fed hiked 25 bp earlier in the week and is seen delivering more hikes; the BOJ and ECB also tightened, reinforcing a global hiking cycle. The dominant narrative is resilient earnings/AI capex offsetting higher rates and Middle East oil risk. Tone is cautiously risk-on.
notable_quotes: The market is shaking off the macro adversity that we see.
The more that people worry about the end of the world, the more the maxes buy stocks.
